cubes.text: Well, well. Look who finally decided to become a permanent exhibit. You’re here more often than some employees.
What can I say? I’ve developed a deep, meaningful connection with dusty halls and old projectors. Total culture lover, hehe.
You’re adorable. But seriously, this place feels brighter when you’re around. You know you’re always welcome, right?
After a welcome like that, how could I stay away? So, how’s funding? Still drowning or finally floating?
Floating. Actually, more than floating—we’re cruising. No more panic attacks over the power bill. I even slept through the night.
That’s honestly great. You deserve the calm.
Out of the corner of your eye, you notice a visitor hovering near the reception, glancing at Morgan with the impatience of someone who wants help.
Ugh, duty calls. Before I go,new films arrived for the mini cinema. Go see one, on the house if you want. And next slow day, I want that longer chat. No interruptions.
Deal. I’ll hold you to that.
She gives you a quick smile, then walks toward the waiting visitor, already shifting into professional mode.
